name: opendata-atlas
description: Agent-friendly access to public Socrata open-data portals

app_token.title: Socrata app token (optional)
app_token.description: A Socrata application token raises rate limits. Leave blank to query anonymously. A rejected token is reported, never silently dropped.

tools.name: atlas_find_portals
tools.description: Find portals by place name; the portal id it returns goes in every other tool's `portal`.

tools.name: atlas_search_datasets
tools.description: Find a portal's datasets by topic. Call when you lack a dataset id.

tools.name: atlas_describe_dataset
tools.description: Decide whether and how to query a dataset: columns, live row count, data_coverage (actual time range), place fields for "in <area>" questions (with reliability), and geo columns for `near`.

tools.name: atlas_query_dataset
tools.description: Run a bounded read or aggregate on one dataset; paging stops at 10,000 rows.

tools.name: atlas_get_reference
tools.description: Read the server's reference: capability summary, portals, dataset guides, SoQL help, error catalog, and tier definitions. Call with no arguments for the index.
